next_step: Run 2-week POC load test on hosted streaming + submit Dedicated capacity pricing
notes:
Topline
- Mid-market e-comm platform: post-purchase support + returns flow automation. Heavy chat/agent workload (conversational UI + automated returns coaching).
- Currently evaluating Redwood Hosted API as first step; likely to move to Dedicated for Black Friday / holiday peaks if POC meets latency and cost targets.

Recent timeline (bulleted CRM style)
- 2025-09-10: initial inbound via pricing form. AE assigned (Marina).
- 2025-10-01: discovery call (30m) w/ product + infra. Notes: "need p95 under customer-visible timeout; can't exceed 800ms for quick replies". Fireflies: ff_2025-10-08_returnsly_intro.
- 2025-10-08: security questionnaire submitted (see drive doc). Asking for SOC2 + KMS options.
- 2025-10-15: demo (streaming + tool-calling examples) led by Rajan (SE). Customer liked streaming token-by-token UI; requested example of function/tool calling to order API.
- 2025-10-22: POC kickoff — configure hosted streaming endpoint, instrument tracing for p95 and token cost. Fireflies: ff_2025-10-22_poc-kickoff.
- 2025-10-29: mid-POC sync: ran synthetic load test (baseline) — 200 concurrent agents, avg session 10 messages, observed p95 ~420ms for simple responses but spike to ~950ms when tool calls + order lookup included.
- 2025-11-01: follow-up call to review telemetry and Dedicated sizing options.

Workload & requirements (explicit)
- Primary workload: customer-facing chat agents for returns and shipping status. Mix of automated assistant + human handoff.
- Traffic profile: high seasonality; 3x normal traffic during Black Friday week; target support for 2,000 concurrent chats during peak with graceful degradation.
- Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end for chat turn (including streaming + one external order lookup) <= 600ms target; hard requirement p95 <= 900ms for degraded flows. Current observed p95 on hosted baseline: 420ms without tool calls, spikes with tool calls.
- Throughput targets: sustain 500–2,000 concurrent sessions depending on season. Burst capacity required.
- Feature needs: streaming responses (token streaming), function/tool calling (order lookup, return label creation), structured JSON outputs for ticketing systems, mutex for KV order-context cache across turns.
- Model preferences: open/quantized models for cost — prefer 13B or 7B quantized variants if quality sufficient; fallback to larger family for escalations. Interested in Redwood model variants / verified profiles.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit economics during peak are predictable. Evaluating dedicated pricing vs. hosted over seasonal workload.

Security & compliance
- Requires SSO/SAML for admin console access, audit logging for all model calls, KMS integration for key management. Data residency request for EU customers (they have EU storefronts) — will need routing/policy controls.
- Legal has DPA redlines in review; SOC2 documentation requested (ticket SEC-2190).

POC plan & acceptance criteria
- Duration: 2 weeks (live traffic sample + synthetic peak ramp).
- Tests: 1) baseline latency (no tool calls), 2) streaming + single tool call latency distribution, 3) peak burst to 2x baseline traffic, 4) failover test to smaller model variant.
- Success metrics: p95 <= 600ms for typical chat turns, <15% increase in per-token cost vs projected, streaming latency under 300ms to first token for 80% of requests, function-calling end-to-end < 400ms additional overhead for order lookup.

Commercials & procurement notes
- ARR expectation: 75k–200k year 1 if Dedicated chosen for peak windows + optimize consult.
- Wants price examples: hosted vs Dedicated for 500/1000/2000 concurrent steady states; request sent for a committed capacity discount schedule.
- Procurement: procurement + legal loop likely to add 4–6 weeks after technical signoff.

Quotes / direct snippets from calls
- Product lead: "We need predictable latency during Black Friday; last year chat times killed conversion."
- Ops: "If we can get a guaranteed p95 and autoscale for spikes, we'll move fast on an annual commit."

Next steps (short)
- SE (Rajan) to run two synthetic peak load tests on hosted streaming with tool-calling instrumentation (due 2025-11-05).
- AE (Marina) to share Dedicated pricing deck + committed discount tiers (drive link).
- Legal to get SOC2 artifacts; goal to clear DPA redlines by 2025-11-20.

Blockers (recap)
- Legal DPA redlines; SOC2 evidence requested.
- Need SSO test account to validate admin flows.
- Cost modelling for peak + committed discount to align with finance.

Other notes (CRM flavor)
- Customer prefers demo code in Node + Python for streaming; asked for a sample of function-calling flow that returns structured json with ticket_id and processing_time_ms.
- Raised question about caching & KV reuse across sessions for quicker order lookups — consider Redwood Optimize suggestions for caching TTLs.
- Internal advocate: Head of Product (Maria Gomez) — pushing for quick decision if POC looks good.
